No two noses are the same. So I measure every one before I touch it.
His nose, his face, his plan. Nothing copied, nothing standard.
That is the whole point of a consultation — the surgery is built for you, not for a photo.
Would you let anyone operate on your nose without measuring it first? Comment "1" or DM me.
